messages:
elaine: Heads-up — planning a small autoscaler policy change for dedicated GPU pools tonight. Goal: reduce minReplicas from 2->1 for low-usage pools to cut cost. Who can own timing + smoke checks?
raj: I can own the deploy. target window 23:00 UTC? works for me.
sam: 23:00 UTC is fine. please ping me 15m before so I can warm the test model.
sneha: PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4589 — changes in helm values and a unit test for metric threshold. needs a quick review.
raj: @sneha reviewing now. quick question — any pools excluded from this change? e.g., reserved pools for enterprise customers.
sneha: yes, we added a label filter: pool-tier!=enterprise. only default and burst pools affected. code snippet in PR: `--set autoscaler.minReplicas=1 --set pool.selector='!enterprise'`
sam: deploy-bot: CI results?
deploy-bot: CI ✅ all checks passed for PR #4589 (unit, lint, integration). image built: registry/redwood/infra:autoscaler-1.2.3
raj: plan: 23:00 UTC helm upgrade in staging -> smoke -> prod canary (10% pools) at 23:15 -> full rollout at 23:45 if no regressions. rollback plan: `helm rollback infra-autoscaler <previous-release>` or reapply previous values file.
elaine: smoke checklist: 1) run `curl -s https://staging-dedicated.redwood/health` 2) hit a model endpoint with a 10-request burst and check latency < 300ms 3) check `queue_length` metric in prometheus < 5 for 10m 4) ensure KV cache hit-rate doesn't drop >5%
sre-oncall: I'll be on watch for the first 60m after full rollout, will have pager forwarded. Set alert: `dedicated_pool_high_queue` to severity P1 if > 30 for 5m.
raj: noted. I'll post a short summarised runbook in the channel 10m before. @sam please run the smoke curl and basic latency test first in staging. @sneha keep the PR ready to revert values if needed.
sam: Will do the smoke tests and paste output.
elaine: small ask — can we keep autoscaler logs for 24h in staging, 72h in prod for this change? helps debugging.
sneha: added an env var to helm values to increase log retention for 72h in prod.
raj: All right — owner assigned, PR reviewed, CI green, deploy window set. I'll kick off at 23:00 UTC and post timestamps for canary/full. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks team :rocket:
